items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: there was two of them that played out there with, uh, with, uh, Andrew Jefferson. This other fellow played trumpet too... Al Fonce, Al Fonce

ctx.x: What about, when did you have Herb Moran?
Little Fonce, Al Fonce, call him, uh, Fonce, Al Fonce, little brown-skinned fellow, he worked for the mail service.
